name: Fresh-fiat surge rotating to ETH -> targeted ETH long (net-flow + ETH-share)
rationale: ECONOMIC MECHANISM (distinct from both the aggregate net-flow long and the bare ETH-share rotation: this REQUIRES fresh dry powder AND that it is landing on ETH rails, i.e. it conditions the dry-powder-deployment thesis on the ROTATION being toward ETH specifically — capturing the case where new fiat is not just entering the perimeter but choosing Ethereum, a sharper directional ETH nowcast than either leg alone): a positive stablecoin_net_flow_usd surge is fresh fiat that must deploy; stablecoin_eth_share rising says it is concentrating on ETH. Together they point new demand at ETH before it hits ETH spot. Long ETH; exit on flow fade or stop/TP/time. DISCONFIRMER 1: the two legs may be mechanically correlated (a big ETH mint raises both) -> if they never disagree they are one signal; require the combo to beat each single leg's deflated Sharpe. DISCONFIRMER 2: flow/price correlation <0.3 at short horizons (Kaiko/Glassnode) is the base death risk; require positive lead coefficient after BH-FDR. DISCONFIRMER 3: eth_share short/revised history -> verify PIT. Net of fees, DSR>=0.95.
catalyst: fresh stablecoin fiat rotating onto ETH rails
